scope: Native MedRAX graph routing integration using a scripted controller and real CheXagent; not full six-tool or live controller qualification
hypothesis: Shared guard is applied on native Agent tool path, visual encoding executes for accepted single images and invalid inputs return failure without generation
panel: same two privacy-approved D1/D2 images, no new source or target labels
gate: both accepted cells complete with one current-image encoding; both rejected cells have zero generations; all four return a ToolMessage to scripted graph controller and terminate
retry_policy: preserve failed cells, no automatic costly reruns
method_link: Mandatory shared correctness layer for every future H0/Raw/Fixed/Proposed arm; does not count as learned skill
